scientific_integrity: Theorem includes a self-contained geometric proof and exact checker for q=7,49; finite enumeration does not establish the infinite statement. Earlier Jacobian decompositions are explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Smooth marked type-(2,4) genus-five Humbert curves in characteristic 7 only; finite-field counts are ordered coefficient pairs, not geometric isomorphism counts; no other characteristics or boundary fibres. Historical originality coverage may be incomplete.
title: Characteristic-seven Humbert curves: a missing \(7\)-rank and exact finite-field strata
